meta.authority: muftyat.kz (Spiritual Administration of Kazakhstan) year tables
meta.capture_agent: c19-year2 (scripts/kz_pull*.sh; values rendered by the site in agent-browser)
notes: muftyat.kz has no server API; the published tables are computed in the browser by the site own PrayTimes.js (fajr 15, isha 15, asr Hanafi, highLats AngleBased, dhuhr/maghrib 0 min) and the capture read the rendered rows.
Capture patched prayTimes.getDst=0 to defeat the site host-DST defect (a DST-zone browser adds an hour to summer rows).
Years 2030 and 2036 are served by the same simple solar algorithm; drift far from now is the site own.
Row dates carry no year; the year comes from the per-file table header, verified per file.
Almaty (2025, 2026, 2027, 2030) and Shymkent (2026) series exist in the same folder and are excluded: one city per file.
